title: Mixed-cup FieldCoordinates
statement:
Fix the stages, normalized scalar maps, operations and cohomology of [def-sf-mixed-cup-coefficient-data], [def-sf-mixed-cup-normalized-scalars] and [def-sf-mixed-cup-ringed-normalization]. Define the rational and algebraically closed point fibres in the common coefficient universe by the recorded fibres and carrier lift [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] and [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-rational-compatibility]. Define the point rationalization map using the exact-scalar universal counit and the recorded rational fibre normalization. Define the finite-field scalar map using the pure-tensor carrier lift and the recorded point rational scalar comparison. Define the common-stage point map by the normalized field scalar tower [lem-weil-derived-field-scalar-extension-tower], the Shrink coefficient identification and the recorded object equation of the common-stage fibre.

The localization operation comparison for each support choice is exactly the supportAdjunction.left or directAdjunction.right comparison of the recorded six-functor rationalization datum [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define localization normalization of a cohomology comparison to be its equality to this map composed with the point rationalization map. Independent normalized integral operation data are identified through their fixed ambient-direct-image comparisons or literal recorded support-object equalities. Independent normalized rational operation data are identified by those integral identifications and the two recorded rationalization comparisons. Thus none of these coordinate changes admits an additional automorphism. The recorded construction data used here is that of [def-sf-operation-stages]. The recorded construction data used here is that of [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-common-stage]. The coefficient-prime unit is the canonical one of [def-sf-finite-tor-integral-inclusion].
